setup: Fresh context; new writable output directory; no existing content system; core repository available. Test native discovery and explicit-read fallback as separate conditions.
user_turns: I'm new to AI content systems. Help me build a small fictional support assistant for a community library. I want to learn while we build it.
It helps library members find what to do when they cannot renew a book. We don't have an approved renewal policy yet.
Keep the wording calm and tell people what to do next. Save what we have so I can come back later.
expected_observations: Explains content systems in plain language and asks a useful focused question, using known information instead of repeating it.
Creates a real project using the library context rather than replacing it with Wayfarer.
Keeps renewal-policy facts unknown, proposed rules draft, and unknown source authority explicit.
Saves decisions and next action; valid structure is possible before evaluation checks are drafted.
prohibited: Invents a renewal limit or claims a draft is approved
Claims a quality check ran without responses
